purpose: Compare completed CUDA work and global versus shared histogram atomics
first_iteration: retained separately, first invocation of condition after device discovery, not cold process
histogram_experiment: global atomics versus private block shared bins, same tile ownership and exact counts
baseline: optimized CPU using up to two threads, AVX2 where supported, same validation and outputs
cuda_timing: events on one stream bracket H2D, kernels and D2H; stream synchronized before results or memory release
host_timing: same outer steady_clock boundary for CPU and CUDA, including validation, allocations, copies, launch, synchronization, checksum selection, result destruction and CUDA cleanup
notes: pageable host buffers, no transfer overlap claim
event durations are not added to host elapsed time
no Python or runtime queue costs included
profiler run separate from timing samples
record device, driver, toolkit, source, binary hash and contention
